citations.assessment: Mishnah gives Yose Katnuta and קטנותן. The Yerushalmi gives תמציתן, explicitly including the righteous as well as the pious.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The reciprocal entry transmits the Katnuta tradition. Heilprin’s chronology here is an inference.
The dialogue is verified in the digital Introduction. Preserve Heilprin’s title and printed locator pending folio collation.
The quotation abbreviates Jeremiah by omitting the intervening words about kingdoms, as marked by Heilprin.
The passage assigns resurrection to both prophets and withholding and restoring rain to Elijah alone. The English retains Heilprin’s compressed wording.
The Zohar witness reads Yose and Ketem Paz reads Yosef. Both place the conversion at Kefar Shechalayim, against the shorter spelling in Heilprin.
